title: Cosmetic GitHub writes in StamphogGitHubClient must fail open and run at BATCH priority
answers: Why does hiding a dismissed stamphog review never raise or retry?
How do I add a best-effort cosmetic GitHub call to the stamphog client?
Stamphog dismissed approval hide as outdated failure handling
body:
Cosmetic writes on the client (the 👀 reaction, `_minimize_as_outdated`) must not fail or retry the caller. The approval is already retracted, so a failed hide must never retry the dismissal.
- `github_client.py:_minimize_as_outdated` catches request exceptions, non-200, non-JSON and GraphQL `errors`, each with its own `stamphog_github_minimize_dismissed_review_*` warning. Logs carry status or error types only, never bodies.
- It calls `_request(..., priority=Priority.BATCH)` so the egress limiter sheds it before dismissals. `_request` defaults to `Priority.CRITICAL`; keep that default for real writes.
- `dismiss_pr_review` still returns early on 422 (already inactive) and skips the hide. Extracting `node_id` from the dismissal response is also guarded, so a non-JSON 200 cannot raise.
- Tests: `test_logic.py:CosmeticWriteFailOpenTests` must assert the hide was attempted for each failure mode.
